preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of magnets n in each test case must be between 3 and 2000.
The total sum of all n over all test cases must not exceed 2000.

postconditions.description: The output must be in the format '! k A', where k is the number of demagnetized magnets and A is the list of their indices.
The length of the list A must equal k, the number of demagnetized magnets found.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= n for index in A)
postconditions.description: All indices in A must be valid indices of the magnets, between 1 and n.
